title: Native derived morphisms represented by raw cohomology classes
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, a morphism k:W→S, a module sheaf G on W, an integer q, an etale U over S and A over W, read a value z of higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor(Λ,k,G,q,U) at A [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-diagram] as the very same derived morphism from the single of (A.hom≫k)*freeSheaf(Λ,S)(U) to higherDirectImageRawOverComplex(Λ,G,A)[q] [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-over-complex]. Independently, for h:Y→S, an abelian sheaf H on Y, a natural q and U etale over S, read a value x of abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf(h,q,H) [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison] as the same morphism from the single of h*freeAbelian(S,U) [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison] to H[0][q]. Both maps are the identity on the input under the defining raw Yoneda presentation; no choice, new object or coefficient comparison is made.
